probes.instruction: Lean in and tell me if water's spilling into the tall middle tube
probes.observe: whether water is spilling into the overflow tube
probes.result: no water spilling into the tall middle tube

updates.against: no water spilling into the tall middle tube

probes.instruction: Press down gently on the red flapper I've marked and tell me if the running stops?
probes.observe: Whether the running water sound stops when flapper is pressed down
probes.result: running sound did not stop while pressing flapper

updates.against: running continued when flapper was pressed down
running continued when flapper was pressed down

steps.label: Turn off water
steps.instruction: Look low behind the toilet and turn that oval shutoff knob clockwise by hand until it stops
steps.pass_condition: they say the knob is fully clockwise and will not turn further

attempts.seen: They said they did it and the shutoff knob is low behind the toilet out of view so the photo cannot judge it.

steps.label: Flush tank empty
steps.instruction: Flush the toilet and hold the handle to drain the tank empty
steps.pass_condition: they say the tank is drained and no more water flows in

attempts.seen: They only said yeah to tightening the knob and never said the tank is empty, and the tank still shows water inside.
attempts.correction: Please hold the flush handle down until the tank drains empty and no more water is coming in.

steps.label: Swap fill valve
steps.instruction: Unhook the refill tube, unscrew the old fill valve and lift it out, then fit and tighten the new fill valve and reattach the refill tube
steps.pass_condition: they say the new fill valve is seated tight with the refill tube attached

steps.label: Turn water on
steps.instruction: Turn the shutoff knob counterclockwise slowly to let the tank refill
steps.pass_condition: they say water is refilling the tank

steps.label: Test flush stops
steps.instruction: Flush once and watch the tank refill and shut off on its own
steps.pass_condition: they say the tank refilled and the running stopped on its own

verifications.seen: They said they did it and the shutoff knob is low behind the toilet out of view so the photo cannot judge it.
They only said yeah to tightening the knob and never said the tank is empty, and the tank still shows water inside.
verifications.correction: Please hold the flush handle down until the tank drains empty and no more water is coming in.

stopped: Shutoff valve fully closed but still lets water by, so fill valve cannot be safely swapped – needs plumber to replace shutoff valve

cautions.name: open tank water
cautions.line: Water nearby. Keep the headset clear.

cautions.line: Lid off. Flushing can splash headset.
